title: Taking Up Running
sentences: I never thought of myself as someone who could enjoy running.
A colleague invited me to join a running group that met near the park each weekend.
During my first attempt, I could barely finish without stopping to catch my breath.
Although it was embarrassing, everyone in the group was patient and encouraging.
Since then, I've gradually built up my distance week by week.
While running, I often forget about whatever is worrying me that day.
My knees ached badly at first, so I invested in a proper pair of shoes.
Once I switched shoes, the pain disappeared almost completely.
If the weather is terrible, we still meet, although we sometimes shorten the route.
I've made several good friends through the group who share my new hobby.
Running has become something I genuinely look forward to each week.
